question: Under what condition of practice over one year are old age and death said to be destroyed?
premises: Practice is undertaken for one year.
When that practice has been performed, a condition obtains.
Under that condition, old age and death are destroyed.
inference: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: The specific practice referred to is not named in this verse.
plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
